commit_scope: Keep the public API and Hati Sheet carrier stable after deployment maintenance by proving a consecutive local-and-public readiness window and performing at most one route re-registration repair.

task_card.goal: Restore app.hati.earth Sheet tracking and make the API public route resilient to post-maintenance disappearance or restart oscillation.
done_when: Both aligned and rebuilt deployment paths require three consecutive local and public API responses without a container restart after maintenance.
A lost public API route receives one bounded container re-registration during deployment and one bounded repair during public verification.
Exact-head CI/review, merge, production rollout, public API/Hati checks, deployment observation, and authenticated Hati Sheet-state checks pass.
constraints: Keep every repair bounded; do not create a restart loop.
Require both localhost process proof and the public Traefik door before declaring the release stable.
Keep Sheet, household, balance, token, nonce, and SSH material out of repository evidence.

evidence_refs: Hostinger run 38096585594 deployed exact main SHA 64e5ef20a3e52df93c8b909d874ff1f532cae58a and passed container-local health and grounding before the public API door alternated among 200, 404, 502, and timeout responses.

Direct-origin and Cloudflare probes both returned the same Traefik 404 while app.hati.earth and hati.earth/people/urs remained HTTP 200, locating the failure at API service discovery rather than the private Sheet.
The prior verifier retried the same external checks without repairing the disappeared route; the new carrier performs one bounded API recreate before retrying.
The post-maintenance gate now observes the same container identity and restart count across three consecutive localhost and public ping successes.
Exact-head review required Compose capability detection and bounded readiness polling so a health timeout cannot trigger a second recreate and a no-wait start cannot fail on one premature ping.
No secret, token, nonce, household value, balance, private Sheet URL, or SSH material is present in this evidence.

commands: shell syntax for both deployment carriers
local PR guard and strict PR follow-through
local_validation.summary: The deployment cannot finish on a single localhost success: it now proves a restart-free local and public window and turns the first public-verifier failure into one active route repair.

e2e_validation.expected_behavior_delta: The API remains publicly routable after deployment grounding, allowing app.hati.earth to read its available Sheet without presenting the unavailable state.
test_flows: Observe an exact-head Hostinger rollout remain stable through the post-maintenance public window.
Observe authenticated deployment recording and native recorded-answer readback.
Reload authenticated Hati and confirm the balance label is present without any unavailable, retrying, connecting, or fallback state.
